C-AS-STATE.Summary: Deliver RM-GOVERNED-PATH P1 step 6: an as-state lint preview. Argv token as takes a ChangeStatus from the live CHANGE_STATUSES export, evaluates only artifact-pure rules against a virtual status and the location that status set implies, and reports derived N/M coverage so silence cannot read as will pass. Target and final are not accepted values: they are already LintAssertionMode members, and validateAssertions is impure. P2 is out.
C-AS-STATE.Problem:
**Shared shape.** P1.6 asks lint to preview the rules that fire at "approve / target / final" of a hand-edited draft. Generators already cover write-time. This is evolution-time. Authoring HEAD a7925cf on feat/as-state, packaged 6.2.0, lint 0/0, archive 37, active empty before this bundle, suite 1389 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail. Those numbers are a snapshot (F33).
---
**The step's vocabulary is incoherent, measured.** approve is a gate (ngrace gate approve, apply, archive). target and final are LintAssertionMode members (current, baseline, target, final at src/lint/types.ts:38; argv token assertions at src/grace-lint.ts:142-147). Shipping lint with argv token as taking target would sit beside lint with argv token assertions taking target and mean something else. Three roadmap claims in this phase have already failed construction (P1.11 permanently blocked, P1.4 zero-depth globstar, P1.8 delayed IMPL=0 mystery). This sentence is the fourth candidate.
---
**The purity bound forbids the target/final half.** validateAssertions (src/lint/core.ts:317-410) needs GraphProjection and VerificationProjection and, with runCommands, shells out and appends to the run ledger (appendCommandRunEvent, :333-336). An approximate as-state of those rules would be an authored claim of doneness outrunning its evidence. The step itself says that is permanent, not a v1 compromise. So the roadmap's own target/final values are unsatisfiable under the roadmap's own purity bound.
---
**What the product actually has.** CHANGE_STATUSES is draft, approved, applied, rejected, cancelled, superseded (src/artifact/types.ts:134-142). Active = draft, approved. Archived = applied, rejected, cancelled, superseded. Eight status-gated lint checks are all pure (they read status attributes and location). evaluateApproveGate (src/gates/core.ts:258) is artifact-only. evaluateApplyGate (:300) is mixed: plan-present and the AC clarification check are artifact-only; review-verdict and host-capability read the ledger. evaluateArchiveGate (:408) is ledger-only. No shipped feature previews a future lifecycle status.
---
**There is no typed-absence text surface.** formatTextReport (src/lint/core.ts:604-654) renders every issue identically and never reads issueClass. JSON carries issueClass only as a field on LintIssue. grace-doctor's partitionAbsenceIssues / absenceCountsByReason (src/grace-doctor.ts:83-98) is a filtered list plus counts by code, not an evaluated-N / not-evaluable-M sentence. The absence report has to build its surface.
---
**D13 blocks the obvious JSON home.** LintResult top-level keys are pinned exactly at src/lint/core.test.ts:383-408. Putting asStatus beside assertionMode would fail that pin. A WeakMap (D13's answer for the baseline count) cannot appear in JSON, and JSON silence would read as will pass. The nest must live under summary. finalizeResult (src/lint/core.ts:100-104) currently rebuilds summary as exactly issues, errors, warnings and would drop a nest that is not written back.
---
**F66.** This spec must decide README.md and examples/ in a Goal, Constraint, or NonGoal body. README.md is in scope. examples/ is unchanged.
---
**F70 residue.** The README check now walks live invocations. Flags are still not covered. A new as row can go undocumented without failing the check.
---
**F61.** xml.comment-not-well-formed is error severity. This spec names argv tokens and exported functions in any comment body and does not write dashed CLI flags inside XML comments.

Goals.Goal: **As-state preview.** lint argv token as takes a ChangeStatus from the live CHANGE_STATUSES export and evaluates the selected change under the artifact-pure rules that that status would invoke, without writing disk.

**Derived absence report.** Text and JSON both report evaluated N rule classes and M classes not evaluable at this state, with typed reasons. N and M are derived from evaluation entry-point purity, never hand-listed and never frozen (F60, F33).
**README.md documents the flag.** The CLI Overview gains a table row whose first ngrace token cell names lint and the as argv token. F70 flag-coverage residue is not repaired here.

**Decided here — vocabulary.** Argv token as is a string option on lint, matching change, explain, profile, failOn, and assertions. It will not move the boolean-site pin (25 at this HEAD). Accepted values are exactly the members of the live CHANGE_STATUSES export. Do not hand-copy the six names into a second list (F60). Refuse any other token as invalid-arguments before lint runs. The refusal names the accepted members by reading that export. When the rejected token is a LintAssertionMode member, the message also names argv token assertions as the flag that already takes that token. When the rejected token is a live gate name (the same inventory ngrace gate already walks), the message says that token is a gate verb and this flag takes a ChangeStatus. Those two refusal shapes must be able to fail alone (F68). This is why the roadmap's approve / target / final set is rejected: approve is a gate verb; target and final are already assertion modes; and validateAssertions cannot be previewed honestly.

**Decided here — selection.** Argv token as requires argv token change. Missing change, a non-canonical id, or a bundle that exists in neither active nor archive is invalid-arguments (or not-found) at the CLI, before lint runs. Do not reuse resolveSelectedApprovedPlan: that helper demands an approved spec and plan pair (src/lint/core.ts:459-476), which is exactly the state a draft preview is not in (F4). The as-state resolver accepts a spec-only draft and accepts an archived bundle. Parallel-preflight, remediate, failOn, and format compose. Argv token as combined with assertions other than current, with runCommands, or with explain, is invalid-arguments. Default assertions current (omitted or explicit) is the legal companion. Explain currently short-circuits and would silently ignore as; refuse rather than ignore.

**Decided here — purity partition.** A rule class is a purity class of an evaluation entry point, not an issue-code family and not a hand-maintained inventory of the eight status-gated checks. Classify by closed-over inputs. Artifact-pure: reads only parsed artifact XML (status overlay in memory) plus the location implied by which of ACTIVE_CHANGE_STATUSES or ARCHIVED_CHANGE_STATUSES contains the requested status. Ledger-dependent: reads run-ledger, run/, or review verdicts. Verification-runtime: validateAssertions (projections, optional command execution, optional appendCommandRunEvent). N is the count of evaluable purity classes that ran. M is the count of non-pure classes that the requested status would invoke and that this run did not invoke. Do not freeze N or M (F33). Do not publish a list of issue codes as the previewable set (F60). Membership follows the function that ran: split evaluateApplyGate so the artifact-pure half (plan-present and the AC clarification check) is a distinct entry point and the ledger half (review-verdict, host-capability) is another; evaluateApplyGate composes both and keeps today's public result. evaluateApproveGate is already artifact-pure; call it. evaluateArchiveGate is entirely ledger-dependent; do not call it under as. validateAssertions keeps running against real disk status for the rest of the project; the selected change's would-be semantic assertion evaluation is counted in M, never faked. Overlay status only on the selected change's spec and plan, never on design-context or on an artifact that forbids a status attribute.

**Decided here — N/M surface.** Text: when as is set, formatTextReport prints one coverage line immediately after the Warnings header line and immediately before the blank line that precedes either No issues found. or Issues (F44). The line is present on the zero-issue path. It is not a footer after the explain pointers and not a lead before the title. Semantics: evaluated N rule classes; M classes not evaluable at this state, plus the typed reasons when M is greater than zero. Tests assert the rendered bytes (F43). JSON: when as is set, summary gains an asState object holding status (the requested ChangeStatus), evaluatedRuleClasses (N), unevaluableRuleClasses (M), and unevaluable (the derived reason strings, sorted). When as is not set, summary stays issues, errors, warnings only. No new LintResult top-level key, including under as (D13). Do not use a WeakMap: that home cannot appear in JSON and would recreate the silence this step exists to prevent. Do not emit N/M as LintIssue rows: that would move summary.errors / summary.warnings and failOn for a coverage fact. Do not add a lint issue code for the coverage line. finalizeResult must write the nest back when it rebuilds summary. Gate preview issues reuse existing gate codes; any file field this path adds is project-relative POSIX at the emission site (F73).

**Decided here — no mutation.** Argv token as never writes a status attribute, never moves a bundle, never creates or appends a ledger event, and never calls appendCommandRunEvent. The as-state path never constructs onCommandRun. Combined with runCommands is already refused. Enforcement is a fixture whose spec.xml, plan.xml if any, and run-ledger.xml / run/ digest are byte-identical after the invocation, plus the existing writeFileSync inventory staying green because this path adds no writer. Do not add a writeFileSync to lint.

**Decided here — F56 / F67 / F68.** signatureKey names the property: as-vocabulary, as-pure-preview, as-absence-report, readme-as-row. Do not key on a test file stem. Two planned reds in one task must be able to fail alone: the assertions-mode refusal and the gate-verb refusal are separate reds; the D13 top-level pin under as and the asState nest are separate reds. A task may plan at most three distinct kind-plus-key pairs. The boolean site count pin is re-measured only if a boolean lands; a string as must not move it.
